full_details: At rehearsal Arthur said Edith had let the hem down two fingers at Easter and his shins were out again. You did not write him a new lady before dinner, and you did not rename the doors. At the board Mistress Ansell measured the loaf, the first time since Easter, and ruled on the twins while Alse carried the pot. You paid threepence. The firing stayed off. After Errors, Kemp asked for a better door and got the door the play already gives him. You noted that tomorrow's Shrew does not cast you. At night you began the dropped staff on the sheet that already holds Thursday's quarrel, and you marked the new line as foul.
one_sentence: Arthur asked for a taller lady, you played Egeon, and at dinner the loaf was a finger and a half short and still a penny.
title: A short loaf, and Kemp's door
